responsibilities.description: Turns a requested quarter into a UTC date window and decides whether events (treatments, harvests) fall inside that quarter.
responsibilities.name: Quarter window computation

responsibilities.description: Groups hives by their apiary's region, counts hives, counts hives flagged for varroa at quarter end, and computes the share of flagged hives.
responsibilities.name: Per-region hive and varroa flag aggregation

responsibilities.description: Counts treatments started within the quarter in each region, grouped by treatment product name.
responsibilities.name: Treatment counts per product

responsibilities.description: Adds up the kilograms of honey harvested within the quarter for each region and rounds the total to grams.
responsibilities.name: Honey harvest totals

responsibilities.description: Runs the quarterly report use case: loads hives, apiaries, treatments, products and harvests from the repositories and returns region reports sorted by region name.
responsibilities.name: Quarterly report assembly
